title: Throwaway test repositories run no automatic git maintenance
goal: conftest.git_env gives every git child gc.auto=0 and maintenance.auto=false through GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, and a test shows a scenario commit in a git_env repository runs no maintenance.
notes: Measured: git commit --allow-empty in a full kb clone takes 0.14 s, 0.10 s with gc.auto=0 and maintenance.auto=false; tests.py runs about 262 git commits and 6,900 git calls. Expected saving: under a minute of worker time; it also removes detached background maintenance that can hold files while a test deletes its directory. The test has a planted failure: with the two settings removed from git_env it must fail.
